name: 3-Pass Voxelization
definition: A voxelization approach that fixes cracks and missing data in the voxel grid by voxelizing the scene from each of the 3 major axes, requiring 3 render passes.
summary: 3-Pass Voxelization is a rasterization technique that renders geometry from three orthogonal axes to eliminate cracks and occlusion gaps, ensuring complete volumetric coverage for high-fidelity occupancy.
